Name: EQUIP_PARAM_GEM_ST
Description: Defines Ashes of War: which weapon types and affinities each one fits, and the skill it gives. An Ash of War fits a weapon when the weapon's Ash of War Type is 1 or 2, this row allows the weapon's type, the chosen affinity is allowed (only Standard on weapons that disable affinities), the weapon's upgrade row allows this Ash of War Rank, and the weapon isn't a throwing weapon when Disable For Throwing Weapons is set. Once fitted, its skill replaces the weapon's own and its passive and on-hit SpEffects are added. Unique skills are set on the weapon, not here.
